description: Batch reporting microservice times out with HTTP 504 on date ranges greater than 15 days or file sizes > 50MB.
workaround: Instruct client to export in 7-day chunks or download via Chrome Incognito to bypass cached tokens.

issue_title: Driver GPS telemetry marker drift on Android 14
description: Aggressive OEM battery optimization suspends WebSocket telemetry on backgrounded driver apps.
workaround: Instruct driver to disable 'Battery Optimization' and grant 'Allow all the time' location permission.

issue_title: CSV Roster parser failure on non-UTF8 special characters
description: Uploading shift rosters containing unencoded accented characters or trailing commas throws silent parsing exception.
workaround: Open roster in Excel, re-save as 'CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)', and verify uppercase column headers.

issue_title: SMS Telecom Gateway Delivery Failure on Boarding OTP
description: Secondary telecom provider experiencing 6-minute message queue delays during morning peak hours (06:00 - 08:30).
workaround: Use dispatcher admin console 'Manual Boarding Verification' toggle or trigger resend via WhatsApp backup route.

issue_title: Night Surcharge Contract Rate Card Cache Staleness
description: Mid-month contract amendments for toll and night multipliers do not refresh until the nightly cache purge.
workaround: Trigger billing tariff recalculation via Admin Console > Client Contracts > Re-sync Tariffs.

issue_title: Driver Vehicle Compliance Document Upload 413 Payload Too Large
description: Mobile document scanner uploads raw 12MP images exceeding 10MB web server payload limit.
workaround: Use built-in app document compressor or capture image using standard resolution 1080p camera mode.
